_comment: ngsolve hdivdiv#0 (HDivDiv is nn-conforming, weaker than H2). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604. Pins the continuity STRUCTURE of the space with exact facet-jump quadratic forms on a fixed pseudo-random member: HDivDiv rel nn jump ~1e-17 and rel tt jump ~2.3; MatrixValued(H1,symmetric) has BOTH jumps exactly 0.
